tool.name: IMAGINE-X subhkl Prepare Peaks
tool.command:
umask 0000 && export CUDA_CACHE_PATH=/tmp/cuda_cache XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp/xdg_cache XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/tmp/xdg_config && mkdir -p out && chmod 0777 out && cp "$sitecustomize_script" sitecustomize.py && export PYTHONPATH=".:\${PYTHONPATH:-}" &&
#set $wl_opts = "" #if str($wavelengthMin) != "": #set $wl_opts = $wl_opts + " --wavelength-min " + str($wavelengthMin) #end if #if str($wavelengthMax) != "": #set $wl_opts = $wl_opts + " --wavelength-max " + str($wavelengthMax) #end if
#set $input_args = "" #set $src_file_opts = "" #for $Z in $inputs: #set $input_args = $input_args + ' "' + str($Z.input) + '"' #set $src_file_opts = $src_file_opts + ' --source-file "' + str($Z.input) + '"' #end for export SUBHKL_SHARED_DIR="\${SUBHKL_SHARED_DIR:-/gpfs/neutronsfs/scratch/subhkl_shared}" HDF5_USE_FILE_LOCKING=FALSE && LOCAL_SCRATCH="\$(mktemp -d -p "\${SUBHKL_STAGING_DIR:-\${TMPDIR:-/tmp}}" subhkl_reduce_XXXXXX)" && trap 'rm -rf "\$LOCAL_SCRATCH"' EXIT && python -u -m subhkl.io.parser reduce-batch $input_args --output-dir "\$LOCAL_SCRATCH" --instrument $instrument $wl_opts && python -u -m subhkl.io.parser merge-images "\$LOCAL_SCRATCH/*.reduce.h5" "\$LOCAL_SCRATCH/scan_master.h5" $a $b $c $alpha $beta $gamma "$spaceGroup" --shared-pointer-out out/scan_ref.json --instrument "$instrument" $src_file_opts && rm -rf "\$LOCAL_SCRATCH" && chmod -R a+rwX out

repeat.name: inputs
repeat.title: Input Files
repeat.help: As full file paths inside /SNS or /HFIR

tool.help: Reduce raw NeXus files into per-bank 2D count images and merge into a master scan.h5 stack for subhkl solve.
